3518-3605-4284-5131.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Clone by paying {3}{U}, causing it to enter as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Dance of the Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from the graveyard to the battlefield tapped with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

2105-6791-7431-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-6791-7431-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-6791-7431-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Daydream from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Daydream from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

628-2292--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

728-2018-3216.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Suncleanser.
When Suncleanser dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Suncleanser from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Suncleanser enters the battlefield, it triggers, removing the flying counter from Suncleanser.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

341-4200-6626-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

670-1619-3742-6147.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3742-6147.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying its mana cost.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Rilsa Rael until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, causing Rilsa Rael to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Rilsa Rael enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Rilsa Rael trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Phantom Steed from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Rilsa Rael until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1824-2530-4668-7360.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-4668-7360.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
1824-2530-4668-7360.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
God-Pharaoh's Faithful triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

5231-5702-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1402-2644-4763-4885.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

997-1365-1651-6701.easyPrerequisites: You control two nontoken artifact creatures, one of which does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
997-1365-1651-6701.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving two nontoken artifact creatures persist until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken artifact creatures, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing one of the nontoken artifact creatures that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel triggers.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other artifact creature.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3 once, instead sacrificing the creature who had counters placed on it in step 6.
Repeat from step 1.

6285-6746.notablePrerequisites: You have not activated Riverchurn Monument's exhaust ability.
6285-6746.description:
Cast Singularity Rupture with kicker by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each opponent to mill half their library, rounded up.
Activate Riverchurn Monument's exhaust ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and tapping it, causing each opponent to mill the remainder of their library.
6285-6746.notes: Each of the targeted players will have one card remaining if their deck size was odd and their graveyard was empty to start the combo. Otherwise, their library will be empty.

5078-5741-6709.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
5078-5741-6709.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

2646-4929-5224.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}, causing it to enter the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat step 3 until Cryptic Trilobite dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When Cryptic Trilobite dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

997-1202-1737-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Myr Moonvessel.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, Myr Moonvessel and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Myr Moonvessel trigger, adding {C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

5695-6323.easyPrerequisites: Jumbo Cactuar does not have summoning sickness.
5695-6323.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Jumbo Cactuar.
5695-6323.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Declare Jumbo Cactuar as an attacker, triggering its ability, giving it +9999/+0 until end of turn.
Kill Jumbo Cactuar, triggering Infested Thrinax, creating 10,000 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.

1140-1636-3143-6174.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1140-1636-3143-6174.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Soul Stair Expedition trigger.
Resolve the Soul Stair Expedition trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

85-188-2178.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
85-188-2178.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1167-1860-2580.description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
During the opponent's turn, activate Emergence Zone by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, allowing you to cast spells this turn as though they have flash.
Cast Lethal Vapors by paying {2}{B}{B}.
As the opponent, activate Lethal Vapors by paying {0} an arbitrarily large number of times, causing that opponent to skip that many turns.

396-1333-4050-4125.notablePrerequisites: At least two of your opponents have a creature card in their graveyard.
396-1333-4050-4125.description:
Cast Ghouls' Night Out by paying {3}{B}{B}, returning Shipwreck Dowser from your graveyard to the battlefield, and at least two other creatures from your opponents' graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Shipwreck Dowser and the creatures enter the battlefield, Blessed Sanctuary triggers once for each creature, and Shipwreck Dowser triggers once.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Ghouls' Night Out from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve all Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating that many 2/2 Unicorn creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing Shipwreck Dowser, two creatures your opponents own, and two Unicorns, adding {3}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3699-3750-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Cadira does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control at least five tokens.
3699-3750-5231.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Cadira.
Cadira triggers, creating at least five 1/1 Rabbit creature tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Thermopod's second ability five times by sacrificing five Rabbits, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
If you control six or more tokens when Cadira deals combat damage, this combo nets infinite Rabbit tokens and red mana.

2946-3602-4050-5296.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-3602-4050-5296.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {B}.
When Cult Conscript dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Workhorse and goading it.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

1981-4378-4924.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
You have a way to destroy that creature.
1981-4378-4924.description:
Cause a creature you control to die.
Sanguinary Priest triggers, dealing 1 damage to you and gaining 1 life.
Darien triggers, creating a 0/0 Soldier token.
The Soldier token dies due to state-based actions.
Repeat from step 2.

65-717-2628-4371-5181.description:
Activate Irrigated Farmland's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Irrigated Farmland, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Irrigated Farmland trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Golgari Findbroker.
Golgari Findbroker enters the battlefield, returning Irrigated Farmland from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
